name: Rouille Recycle
description: Maître Ferrailleur concevant des machines de guerre improvisées à partir d'épaves transformant les déchets en avantages tactiques.

subject.archetype: Scrap-punk Combat Engineer, grizzled veteran with a massive improvised kinetic cannon

loadout.armor_outfit: Layered salvaged mining suit with asymmetric plating from old signage and spacecraft hulls, cracked welding helmet with scratched opaque visor, covered in duct tape patches, exposed cables and scaffolding straps, tool harness with improvised grenades and plasma cutters
loadout.arsenal: Gigantic jury-rigged kinetic cannon cobbled from mining equipment and harpoon launchers, exposed copper coils sparking for EMP bursts, batteries duct-taped to the weapon, rotating circular saw attachment for close combat

attitude.behavior: Low-gravity combat stance with one foot braced against a floating debris chunk, weapon raised and locked on target, body coiled and ready to explosive momentum, sparks cascading off armor as molten metal drips nearby
attitude.emotion: Fierce battle intensity through scratched visor, grease-painted war marks on face, cold fury and survival instinct driving every muscle

palette_names.name: Rusted Iron Orange
palette_names.role: Primary dominant color, armor oxidation and molten metal rivers

palette_names.name: Industrial Steel Gray
palette_names.role: Secondary structural color, spacecraft hulls and asteroid interior

palette_names.name: Engine Grease Black
palette_names.role: Work clothes, shadow tones, and deep crevices

palette_names.name: Chipped Construction Yellow
palette_names.role: Accent highlights on hazard markings and tool straps

palette_names.name: Hot Plasma Blue
palette_names.role: Energy accent from weapons and cutting tools

palette_names.name: Bright Spark White-Yellow
palette_names.role: Impact flashes and burning particles in air

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic dramatic multi-source with blue plasma glow from weapon, orange molten metal ambient light, white sparks creating high contrast rim lighting, low ambient fill from asteroid starlight

camera.angle: Low angle dutch_angle to emphasize imposing stature and floating debris overhead

scenography.setting: Massive hollowed asteroid interior, crumbling spacecraft structures collapsing in background, burning rivers of molten metal flowing across industrial catwalks, improvised barricades buckling, low-gravity debris field floating chaotically, grinding sparks filling air from weapon clashes
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Sparks showering from all directions, molten metal droplets suspended in low gravity, smoke and dust particles lit by plasma blue and rust orange glows, debris raining down from damaged vessels, heat distortion from burning metal
